settings.title: Choose Your Path
settings.text: Begin with a diamond or a setting — whichever inspires you first.

settings.title: Pair & Perfect
settings.text: We match stone and setting, and confirm every detail with you before a single thing is made.

settings.title: Crafted in Italy
settings.text: Your ring is finished by master goldsmiths and delivered fully insured, with papers.

settings.title: Build Your Ring
settings.description: Two ways to begin. Start with the stone that speaks to you, or start with the setting you love — pair them on the stone's page, and our goldsmiths in Italy make the ring.
settings.diamond_text: Search lab-grown stones by shape, carat, color and clarity. Pick one, then choose a setting on its page. Each stone has its own certificate.
settings.diamond_note: Not sure which stone? Every stone page has an Ask form.
settings.setting_text: Browse settings sold without a center stone, then add the diamond you choose. Setting and stone are priced separately, and the total is shown before checkout.
